headline: Government and Ruling Party Make Official: Public Housing to Be Supplied at Yongsan Park and Seoul Seoripul, Among Others
summary: The Lee Jae-myung government and the Democratic Party officially announced public housing supply at several Seoul locations. Sites include Yongsan Park and Seoul Seoripul.
why: Public housing supply plans shape Seoul's residential property market and the outlook for construction and housing finance.
